Metadata.title: MaskinGo
Metadata.description: Plan jobs, assign driver and machine, log hours from the phone and create an invoice draft the same day. Built for Norwegian truck, crane and machine contractors.
Metadata.homeTitle: MaskinGo · Jobs, hours and invoices for machine contractors
Metadata.ogAlt: MaskinGo: from phone call to invoice the same day

Home.title: From phone call to invoice the same day
Home.lead: MaskinGo replaces phone, text messages and Excel for truck, crane and machine contractors: the job, the driver, the hours worked and the invoice in one place.

receive.title: Plan
receive.body: Enter the job and assign a truck or machine and a driver in the calendar.

check.title: Work
check.body: The driver taps On the way, Arrived and Finished. The hours are recorded from those taps.

approve.title: Invoice
approve.body: An invoice draft is made from the approved hours. A person checks it before anything is sent.

Home.notice: This is an early version. Registration and sign-in work; jobs, the driver app and invoices come in later stages.

Permissions.plan_jobsHint: Jobs, calendar and customers, as a dispatcher. The invoicing comes with it.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.languageLead: Saved in your profile, so it follows you to every device.
Settings.nameLead: Shown to your colleagues in the team list.

Team.title: Team
Team.lead: People in {company} and what they may do.
Team.readOnly: Only owners and administrators can invite people and change roles.
Team.inviteLead: Choose a role and create a personal link. Send it to one colleague: they create an account with it and join. The link works once and is valid for 7 days.
Team.roleHint: Administrators manage people. Dispatchers plan jobs and machines. Drivers do the jobs. Accountants check the time and the invoices of finished jobs.
Team.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the link and copy it yourself.

errors.notAllowed: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.lastOwner: The company must keep at least one owner.

Team.linkCreated: Link created for a new {role}. Copy it now: for security it is shown only once.
Team.mainMachineSaved: Main machine saved. It is suggested when this person gets a job.
Team.permissionsLead: They only add to the role. Invoicing, machines and inviting ask for the e-mailed second step at sign-in.
Team.permissionsSaved: Rights saved. They apply from the person's next page.
Team.readOnlyInvite: You can invite drivers and dispatchers. Only owners and administrators change roles and rights.

Customers.title: Customers
Customers.lead: The companies and people {company} works for. Jobs and invoices will use them.
Customers.addLead: Only the name is needed. The rest can be filled in later.
Customers.added: {name} was added. You can set the customer's own prices below.
Customers.invoiceEmailHint: Leave empty if invoices go to the e-mail above.
Customers.noteHint: Only your team sees it, for example “Call before delivery”.

Customers.empty: No customers yet. Add the first one.
Customers.statusActiveLead: The customer is active and can be chosen for new jobs.
Customers.statusInactiveLead: The customer is inactive: it is not offered for new jobs, but its history is kept.
Customers.pricesLead: Write a price per hour for a machine when this customer pays something else than usual. Leave empty to use the machine's usual rate.
Customers.pricesReadOnly: Only owners and administrators can change prices.
Customers.pricesNoMachines: No machines yet. Add machines first, then the customer's own prices.

errors.orgNumberInvalid: This is not a valid Norwegian organisation number (9 digits).
errors.orgNumberTaken: Another customer already has this organisation number.
errors.phoneInvalid: Enter a phone number, for example 912 34 567 or +47 912 34 567.

errors.notAllowed: You are not allowed to do this.

Vehicles.title: Machines
Vehicles.lead: Trucks and machines in {company}. Jobs and invoices will use them.
Vehicles.readOnly: Only owners and administrators can add and change machines.
Vehicles.addLead: Fields marked as optional can be filled in later.
Vehicles.name: Name
Vehicles.nameHint: What the team calls it, for example “Crane truck 1” or “Scania red”.
Vehicles.regNumberHint: For example AB 12345. Leave empty for a machine without plates.
Vehicles.hourlyRateHint: Excluding VAT. Used for invoice drafts later.
Vehicles.minHoursHint: For example 2: a shorter job is billed as 2 hours.
Vehicles.emptyReadOnly: No machines yet. An owner or administrator adds them.
Vehicles.count: {count, plural, =0 {No machines} one {# machine} other {# machines}}
Vehicles.minimum: Min. {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}
Vehicles.statusActiveLead: The machine is in use and can be planned for jobs.
Vehicles.statusInactiveLead: The machine is out of use: it is not offered for new jobs, but its history is kept.

errors.regNumberInvalid: Use 2–10 letters and digits, for example AB 12345.
errors.regNumberTaken: Another machine already has this registration number.
errors.craneInvalid: Enter the crane capacity in tm, for example 20,5.
errors.rateInvalid: Enter an amount, for example 1450 or 1450,50.
errors.minHoursInvalid: Enter hours, for example 2 or 1,5 (at most 24).
errors.notAllowed: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.eveningKindRequired: Choose a surcharge or another hourly rate.
errors.eveningPercentInvalid: Enter a whole percent from 1 to 500, for example 50.

Vehicles.eveningTitle: Higher rate later in the day (optional)
Vehicles.eveningLead: For example +50 % after 15:00. It applies from that time until the work ends, also past midnight.

Join.title: You have been invited to MaskinGo
Join.personalLink: Invitations use a personal link now. Ask the person who invited you to create one for you.
Join.invalidTitle: This invitation link is not valid
Join.invalidBody: It has already been used, has expired or was cancelled. Ask the person who invited you for a new link.
Join.signupLead: Create your account to join. The link works for one person only.
Join.alreadyMember: You already belong to a company, so you cannot join another one.

acceptErrors.notFound: This invitation link is no longer valid. Ask for a new one.
acceptErrors.alreadyMember: You already belong to a company.

Join.sentBody: Your account is created. We sent a confirmation link to your e-mail. Open it to finish, on any device. You are already a member of the company.

Mfa.verifyLead: Owners and administrators can invite people and change roles, so after the password they also confirm by email.
Mfa.sendLead: We will send a sign-in link to <email></email>.
Mfa.step1: Open the email “Your sign-in link”, on this or another device. Check the spam folder if it is not in your inbox.
Mfa.step2: Tap the link and approve the sign-in. This page then opens MaskinGo by itself.

errors.rateLimited: Too many emails were sent. Wait a few minutes and try again.

Mfa.waiting: Waiting for approval… The link can be used once and expires after an hour.

Approve.title: Approve sign-in
Approve.lead: Someone signed in to MaskinGo with your password and is waiting for approval. Approve only if it was you.
Approve.approved: Sign-in approved. Go back to the window where you signed in; it continues by itself.
Approve.declined: Sign-in not approved. If it was not you, someone knows your password: contact the person who runs MaskinGo.
Approve.expired: This link has expired. Ask for a new link on the sign-in page.
Approve.invalid: This link is invalid or was already used. Ask for a new link on the sign-in page.
Approve.error: Something went wrong. Ask for a new link and try again.

Jobs.title: Jobs
Jobs.lead: Jobs for {company}: for whom, where, when and with which machine.
Jobs.addLead: Fill in what the customer asked for. The machine and the driver can be chosen now or later.
Jobs.addressHint: Where the work is, for example Storgata 1, 0155 Oslo.
Jobs.descriptionHint: Optional: loads, weights, access, what to bring.
Jobs.priceNone: No price: the machine has no hourly rate.
Jobs.priceNoMachine: The price is set when a machine is chosen.
Jobs.priceLead: Taken from the customer's own price for the machine, or else the machine's usual rate, when the machine or customer is saved.

statusLead.new: Choose a machine and a driver, and the job is planned.
statusLead.planned: When the work is done, mark the job as done.
statusLead.cancelled: The job is cancelled. It is kept and can be restored.

Jobs.count: {count, plural, =0 {No jobs} one {# job} other {# jobs}}
Jobs.emptyUpcoming: No upcoming jobs. Add one when a customer calls.
Jobs.overlapLead: Change the time, the machine or the driver, or save anyway.

errors.notAllowed: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.notAvailable: The customer, machine or driver is no longer available. Choose again.
errors.needsVehicleAndDriver: Choose a machine and a driver first.
errors.durationInvalid: Enter how long the job is expected to take: from 15 minutes to 24 hours, for example 4 hours 30 min.
errors.locked: The invoice is marked as sent, so the customer, machine, time and status stay as they are.

Jobs.newCustomerLead: Saved together with the job. Address, organisation number and prices can be added on the customer's page later.
Jobs.durationHint: An estimate only: the job may take longer or shorter. The machine and driver are booked for this time.
Jobs.timeNoteHint: Optional, for example: may run until the afternoon if the ground is hard.
Jobs.vehicleSuggestedMain: {name}'s main machine was filled in. You can choose another.
Jobs.vehicleSuggestedUsual: The machine {name} drives most often was filled in. You can choose another.
Jobs.statusLocked: The invoice is marked as sent: the status stays “Done”. Take the mark back in the invoice section to change it.

Calendar.title: Calendar
Calendar.lead: Who and what is busy when. Choose a day to see it hour by hour.
Calendar.withoutVehicle: {count, plural, one {# job without a machine} other {# jobs without a machine}}
Calendar.noVehicles: No machines yet. Add them under Machines.
Calendar.leadDay: Drag a job to another time, or its right edge to make it longer. The pencil opens the job.
Calendar.dayJobs: {day}: {count, plural, =0 {no jobs} one {# job} other {# jobs}}
Calendar.moveBusy: Job {number} at {time}: already busy at this time
Calendar.notMovable: Done and cancelled jobs keep their time.
Calendar.moveFailed: The job could not be moved. Try again, or change the time on the job.
Calendar.dragHint: Tip: drag a job to move it, drag its right edge to change how long it takes, or tap the pencil to edit it.

MyJobs.title: My jobs
MyJobs.lead: Your jobs today and tomorrow. Press a button at each step, so the office knows how it goes.
MyJobs.noJobs: No jobs for you this day.
MyJobs.finishQuestion: Finished with this job? The office then sees it as done.
MyJobs.finishedNote: You have finished this job. Thank you!
MyJobs.closedNote: The office has closed this job.
MyJobs.history: {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}} so far
MyJobs.noteHint: For example: the customer was not there, waited 30 min. At most 500 characters.
MyJobs.noteSaved: Note saved. The office can see it.
MyJobs.officeEmpty: The driver has not reported anything yet.

errors.notAllowed: This is not your job, or you are no longer on it.
errors.notNow: This step does not fit now. The page shows the job as it is.
errors.noteInvalid: Write a note of at most 500 characters.

JobTime.title: Working time
JobTime.lead: Counted from the driver's presses, with the machine's minimum and higher rate. Excluding VAT. Only to look at: nothing is invoiced.
JobTime.waiting: Waiting for approval: counted from the driver's presses
JobTime.noPresses: No working time from the driver's presses yet. Enter the time to approve it.
JobTime.notDone: The time is counted when the job is finished.
JobTime.evening: Of this at the higher rate
JobTime.noPrice: No price: the job has no hourly rate
JobTime.endHint: Earlier than the start means the next morning.
JobTime.reasonHint: Needed when the time differs from the driver's presses or was approved before. Kept with the time.

errors.startInvalid: Enter a start time, for example 07:00.
errors.endInvalid: Enter an end time, for example 16:00.
errors.breaksInvalid: Enter the breaks in minutes, shorter than the working time.
errors.reasonRequired: Write why the time is corrected.
errors.notAllowed: Only the office approves working time. Owners and administrators confirm their sign-in first.
errors.notDone: Only a finished job's time can be approved.
errors.changed: The time changed meanwhile. Reload the page.
errors.locked: The invoice is marked as sent, so the time can't change.

JobFiles.title: Photos and signature
JobFiles.signHint: The customer signs here with a finger.

errors.unreadable: This photo could not be read. Try another one.
errors.notAllowed: You cannot add files to this job.
errors.tooBig: The file is too large (at most 2 MB).
errors.wrongType: Only photos (JPEG) and signatures can be saved.
errors.alreadySigned: The customer has already signed this job.

Invoice.title: Invoice draft
Invoice.lead: The approved working time and the extra lines. Change or remove lines freely: nothing is numbered or sent to the customer.
Invoice.cancelled: The job is cancelled and is not invoiced.
Invoice.noEmail: The customer has no invoice e-mail.
Invoice.openCustomer: Add it on the customer page
Invoice.timeNotApproved: The working time is not approved yet. Approve it above, and it comes into the draft.
Invoice.timeLater: The working time comes into the draft when the job is finished and the time is approved.
Invoice.eveningLine: Working time at the higher rate, {vehicle}
Invoice.timeFromApproval: The working time lines come from the approved time. Correct them in the working time section.
Invoice.added: The line is added to the draft.
Invoice.descriptionHint: For example: Ferry, Gravel 0–16 mm, Travel
Invoice.unitHint: For example: t, km, pcs, h

errors.descriptionRequired: Write what the line is for.
errors.descriptionTooLong: The description can be at most 200 characters.
errors.quantityInvalid: Write a quantity above 0, with at most two decimals.
errors.unitTooLong: The unit can be at most 20 characters.
errors.priceInvalid: Write a price in kroner, with at most two decimals (max 100 000 kr).
errors.vatInvalid: Choose one of the VAT rates.
errors.lineTooLarge: One line can be at most 1 000 000 kr.
errors.notAllowed: You can't change the invoice draft. Owners and admins need two-step sign-in.
errors.cancelled: The job is cancelled, so it has no invoice lines.
errors.locked: The invoice is marked as sent, so the draft is locked.

Invoice.sentLead: Marked as sent on {when}. The draft is locked.
Invoice.sentLeadNumber: Marked as sent on {when}, invoice no. {number}. The draft is locked.
Invoice.markTitle: Sent from another accounting system instead?
Invoice.markLead: If you send this invoice from Fiken, Tripletex or another system, don't issue it here. Mark it as sent: the draft is locked and the job leaves the bell.
Invoice.referenceHint: As in your accounting system, for example 1042
Invoice.unmarkLead: Take the mark back, and the draft can be changed again. Only do this if the invoice was not sent.

markErrors.referenceTooLong: The invoice number can be at most 40 characters.
markErrors.notAllowed: You can't mark invoices. Owners and admins need two-step sign-in.
markErrors.already: The invoice is already marked as sent.

Invoice.issuedLead: Issued on {date}, due on {due}. The invoice is locked: a mistake is corrected with a credit note.
Invoice.issueLead: MaskinGo gives the invoice the next number and makes its PDF. After that it cannot be changed: a mistake is corrected with a credit note.
Invoice.issueConfirm: Issue it now? This cannot be undone.
Invoice.issueNeedsSettings: Fill in the company's invoice details first.
Invoice.issueNeedsBuyer: The invoice needs the customer's address or organisation number.
Invoice.pdfFailed: The invoice is issued, but its PDF could not be made yet. Open it to try again.

issueErrors.notAllowed: You can't issue invoices. Owners, admins and accountants need two-step sign-in.
issueErrors.already: The invoice is already issued or marked as sent.
issueErrors.settingsRequired: Fill in the company's invoice details first.
issueErrors.buyerRequired: The invoice needs the customer's address or organisation number.

Invoice.sendLead: The customer gets the invoice as a PDF attachment. Replies go to the company's e-mail.
Invoice.sendHint: The customer's invoice e-mail. Change it if the invoice should go elsewhere.
Invoice.sendTestHint: Test mode until an accountant has checked the invoices: only .test addresses, and the e-mail goes to the e-mail service's test inbox, not to a person.

sendErrors.testOnly: In test mode only .test addresses can be used.
sendErrors.notConfigured: E-mail sending is not set up yet. Open the PDF and send it yourself.
sendErrors.notAllowed: You can't send invoices. Owners, admins and accountants need two-step sign-in.
sendErrors.tooMany: The invoice was e-mailed 5 times today. Try again tomorrow.
sendErrors.failed: The e-mail could not be sent. Try again in a moment.

Invoices.title: Invoices
Invoices.lead: Finished jobs: approve the working time, check the draft, then issue the invoice here or mark it as sent from your accounting system.
Invoices.error: The list could not be loaded. Try again.

empty.time: No finished jobs wait for their time.
empty.sent: No invoices are marked as sent yet.

action.ready: Check the draft and mark as sent

Invoices.moreSent: {count, plural, one {# older one is} other {# older ones are}} on their jobs.
Invoices.otherSystems: Sending straight from Fiken and Tripletex is on the way. Do you use another system, such as Visma, PowerOffice or 24SevenOffice? Contact us, and we can build the integration your company needs.

InvoiceSettings.title: Invoice details
InvoiceSettings.lead: What your invoices say about your company. Norwegian law (bokføringsforskriften) asks for these on every invoice.
InvoiceSettings.notYet: Each invoice keeps the details it was issued with: a later change here does not change invoices already issued.
InvoiceSettings.orgNumberHint: 9 digits, as in the Brønnøysund Register.
InvoiceSettings.inBusinessRegister: Registered in the Register of Business Enterprises
InvoiceSettings.inBusinessRegisterHint: Adds “Foretaksregisteret”. Required for AS and ASA.
InvoiceSettings.paymentDaysHint: Days from the invoice date to the due date, from 0 to 90.
InvoiceSettings.firstNumberHint: Usually 1. Moving from another system? Continue its numbering. It is locked after the first invoice.
InvoiceSettings.previewLead: The seller part of every invoice will look like this.
InvoiceSettings.termsLine: {days, plural, =0 {Due on the invoice date} one {Due # day after the invoice date} other {Due # days after the invoice date}}
InvoiceSettings.readOnly: Only owners and admins change the invoice details.
InvoiceSettings.missing: Not filled in yet. An owner or admin fills them in before the first invoice.

errors.orgNumberTaken: Another company in MaskinGo already has this organisation number.
errors.postalCodeInvalid: Enter a valid postal code (4 digits in Norway).
errors.bankAccountInvalid: Enter a valid Norwegian account number (11 digits). Check for typos.
errors.paymentDaysInvalid: Enter a whole number of days from 0 to 90.
errors.firstNumberInvalid: Enter a whole number, 1 or more.
errors.notAllowed: Only owners and admins change the invoice details.
errors.firstNumberLocked: The numbering has started: the first number can no longer change.
